_comment: One file per machine, named <COMPUTERNAME>.json, stored in profiles/. Copy this template. Purpose: the next run should read this BEFORE scanning, so it knows what was already decided and already relocated.

disks.note: same diskNumber as C: means relocating here frees nothing

rollbackAvailable._note: if all zero, deletion is irreversible - enforce copy/verify/rename-keep only

doNotTouch.reason: an MCP server executes from npm-cache\_npx on this machine

needsHumanDecision.note: config + cache + document index interleaved; drill down before any move

preexistingOddities.what: Windows built-in per-user aliases point at a path that no longer exists
preexistingOddities.actionTaken: none - documented as pre-existing, deleting aliases can break shell folders
